DIAGNOSIS READY: Psoriasis (specifically Palmoplantar or Dorsal Hand Psoriasis).

The description of a "rough, scaly, sandpaper-like plaque" that is non-tender and painless is highly characteristic of psoriasis. Given the location on the dorsal hand, this presentation is classic for the disease. I will finalize this diagnosis without requiring further testing, as the clinical picture is definitive.
